description:
Upstream footer shows 'qwen3.5 • medium' or 'qwen3.5 • off' for the current thinking level. Our footer shows only the raw model ID like '(ollama) qwen3.5:latest'.

Footer.thinking_level exists in the struct and model_part/1 handles it (renders '#{model_id} · #{level}' when non-nil), but interactive.ex never populates it — the footer is initialized once at startup and the thinking_level field is never set.

Needs: footer update on thinking_level changes (similar to how model_id is updated on model_select events).
title: Footer missing thinking-level indicator (• medium / • off)
